name: Parameters.exists_smul_eq_or_star
summary: Gal(E/ℚ) acts transitively on the primes above p; an element of Gal(E/ℚ) is galOfPlace(P, s)(v) or conj∘galOfPlace(P, s)(v).

steps.claim: w and w′ lie over the same prime pℤ of ℤ (both contain p; checked on nonnegative and negative integers via `FinPlace.natCast_mem_iff_dvd`), so, by transitivity on the primes over p, some g ∈ Gal(E/ℚ) maps w′ onto w: w = g(w′), i.e. g⁻¹(w) = w′ (Mathlib's theorem, applied with P = w′ and Q = w, returns Q = g • P for the image action of g on ideals).
steps.lean:
(IsInvariant.exists_smul_of_under_eq ℤ _ Gal(P.E s/ℚ) w'.1 w
  (by ext (_ | _) <;> simp [*, -Nat.cast_add, @FinPlace.natCast_mem_iff_dvd _ _ _ p])).rec fun g _ ↦

steps.claim: Let v be the place of the embedding Φ_1∘g. Its chosen embedding Φ_v = Φ_1∘galOfPlace(P, s)(v) is Φ_1∘g or the complex conjugate of Φ_1∘g (`Φ_eq_or`). The infinite places act on finite places by preimage, v • w = galOfPlace(P, s)(v)⁻¹(w) (lines 28–32). If Φ_v = Φ_1∘g, then galOfPlace(P, s)(v) = g and v • w = g⁻¹(w) = w′; otherwise galOfPlace(P, s)(v) = conj∘g and conj(v • w) = w′. Memberships are compared through the injective Φ_1 and `phi_mul`.
steps.lean:
⟨_, by refine (Φ_eq_or ((Φ 1).comp g.toRingHom)).imp ?_ ?_ <;> intro e <;> ext <;> simp <;>
  convert smul_mem_pointwise_smul_iff <;> ext <;> apply (Φ 1).injective <;>
  simpa [← phi_mul] using! congr($e _)⟩
